serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: You fucker! Was it you that snitched on me to the police?!
Oh boy…
You: Me? Police? Never!
Landlord: Oh come on! I may have some enemies here and there, but telling cops I know something about girls with bionics and automatons is so stupid that only a handfull of people could pull it off!
He’s not wrong…
You: It wasn’t me, ok? Why would I do such a thing?
Landlord: I don’t know yet…{{wi}} but it’s not like some idiot needs a reason to do stupid shit!
Landlord: Anyway, it was pointless talking with you, goodbye!
